name: Metorial
long_description:
Metorial is the open-source MCP gateway and AI control plane for AI enablement. Your team logs in once with SSO and gets the MCP servers and Skills their role allows, in whatever AI client they use. Every tool call is logged.

Companies use it to roll out Claude or Cursor across the whole company, share Skills between engineers and non-technical teams, give internal agents scoped access, find and block shadow AI, and pass customer security reviews. Teams building agents into their own product use the same 1,000+ integrations with per-user OAuth through one SDK, as an open-source alternative to Composio.

~4,000 GitHub stars across our repos. SOC 2, GDPR, BAAs and on-prem available. Trusted by companies such as Tractive (at Bending Spoons), Super.com, Moonfire and Crunched.
